description: Three needs the plugin carries itself instead of asking the user to hand-edit ~/.claude/settings.json. PreToolUse pre-approves the report writes every teamlead agent makes inside $TEAMLEAD_HOME/runs, plus the handover files /teamlead:cycle writes under $TEAMLEAD_HOME/tasks; it grants only, so anything outside those two trees gets no decision and follows the normal permission flow. A second PreToolUse hook refuses an implementer subagent's write outside the ```scope fence of its own brief — it answers only when the caller is an implementer, its brief is resolvable and that brief declares a fence, so every other write in the session, including the user's own, gets no decision. UserPromptSubmit names the session after the run, in the session that is already open — sessionTitle is only accepted on this event and on SessionStart, so a prompt boundary is the only place a rename can happen, and it never overwrites a title the user chose.
